modules.title: 三类信息的保存和作用范围不同

items.title: 会话记录
items.text: 属于某段对话；继续同一会话时系统可能再次提供，是否保留由会话机制决定。

items.title: 项目规则
items.text: 放在项目中的文件或设置；需要目标项目里的 Agent 实际读取才会成为本轮上下文。

items.title: 跨会话记忆
items.text: 产品可以保存并在后续交互中取回部分信息；保存和召回范围没有统一保证。

modules.title: 记忆不保证每次自动出现
modules.text: 关闭窗口不代表所有产品都会删除会话记录；新会话也不代表偏好一定被保存或取回。重要要求要在目标会话中检查实际加载内容。

lessonPractice.title: 仓库 A 的项目规则写着“不要自动修改共享组件”。你在仓库 B 开了新对话，先怎样确认这条要求会生效？

options.label: 检查新会话加载的规则或记忆；若没有，就在仓库 B 配置或本轮说明并验证
options.feedback: 对。仓库 A 的文件不会自动适用于仓库 B；要检查新会话实际读到的来源，并在需要时补上要求。

options.label: 因为使用同一个 AI 产品，就默认仓库 A 的项目规则也会应用到 B
options.feedback: 项目规则通常随项目读取；同一产品不代表另一个仓库会自动加载仓库 A 的文件。

options.label: 只凭 Agent 以前处理过类似任务，就假设它已记住这条约定
options.feedback: 过去处理过相似任务不代表偏好已保存或在本轮被取回；应检查新会话实际提供了什么。

en.title: Project rules in repository A say “do not automatically edit shared components.” You start a new conversation in repository B. How can you confirm the rule will apply?

options.label: Check the rules or memory loaded in this conversation; if missing, configure it for B or state it here, then verify
options.feedback: Correct. A file in repository A does not automatically apply in B; inspect what the new conversation actually received and add the requirement if needed.

options.label: Assume repository A's project rules also apply to B because it is the same AI product
options.feedback: Project rules are generally loaded with their project; using the same product does not mean repository A's file is automatically read in another repository.

options.label: Assume the Agent remembers the rule because it handled a similar task before
options.feedback: A similar past task does not prove the preference was saved or retrieved in this turn; inspect what the new conversation received.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 这个新对话也要遵守“不要自动修改共享组件”。请先告诉我你本轮实际读取了哪些项目规则或记忆；如果没有这条约定，请先把它加入当前项目规则或本轮要求，再开始改代码。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: This new conversation must also follow “do not automatically edit shared components.” First tell me which project rules or memories you actually loaded for this turn. If the requirement is missing, add it to this project's rules or the current request before changing code.

learning.assumes: You have seen an AI stop referring to earlier instructions after a conversation restarts.
learning.outcome: You can distinguish current conversation history, project rules, and cross-session memory, then check what a new conversation actually loaded.

modules.title: The three sources have different scopes

items.title: Conversation history
items.text: Belongs to a particular conversation. The system may provide it when that conversation resumes; retention depends on the session mechanism.

items.title: Project rules
items.text: Live in project files or settings. The Agent must actually read them in the target project for them to enter the current context.

items.title: Cross-session memory
items.text: A product may save and retrieve selected information in later interactions; there is no universal guarantee about what is saved or recalled.

modules.title: Memory does not appear automatically every time
modules.text: Closing a window does not mean every product deletes conversation history; a new conversation does not guarantee a preference was saved or retrieved. Check what the target conversation actually loaded.

distinctions.label: Conversation history
distinctions.text: Conversation history stores messages from a conversation; the system can provide them again when continuing the same conversation. Retention and continuation depend on the product's session mechanism.

distinctions.label: Project rules
distinctions.text: Project rules are files or settings stored with a project, not personal memory. They apply when the Agent opens and reads that project's rules and do not automatically extend to other projects.
